To Whom It May Concern,  

I have had the pleasure of collaborating closely with Aditi Kapoor over the past three years as a professor and mentor at CloudNest Technologies, where she served as a Staff QA Engineer. Her role demanded rigorous attention to detail, creative problem-solving, and the ability to bridge technical execution with strategic vision—qualities she embodied with distinction.  

Aditi’s expertise in API testing, BDD/TDD, and performance testing has been instrumental in shaping CloudNest’s quality assurance framework. She spearheaded a critical API testing initiative that uncovered a latent vulnerability in a core service, preventing a potential release delay of weeks. Her BDD/TDD approach, implemented across multiple microservices, not only improved test coverage but also streamlined collaboration between dev and QA teams. In one instance, she redesigned a performance testing workflow using k6, reducing test execution time by over 40% while maintaining accuracy.  

What sets Aditi apart is her holistic approach to test strategy design. Over multi-year cycles, she architected a reusable testing framework that became a cornerstone of CloudNest’s SaaS offerings. Her Python-based automation scripts, often integrated with Selenium and Playwright, addressed cross-browser compatibility challenges that had plagued earlier iterations. Beyond technical mastery, she mentored junior engineers, fostering a culture of ownership and precision.  

Aditi’s dedication to excellence and her ability to synthesize complex systems into actionable solutions make her a rare asset. Her work ethic, curiosity, and collaborative spirit have left a lasting impact on our team.  

Sincerely,  
Dr. Rajesh Patel  
Professor of Software Engineering
